blocks.text: For over three decades, South Border has helped shape the sound of Original Pilipino Music (OPM), delivering timeless hits that have become part of the Filipino soundtrack to love, life, and cherished memories. On Saturday, January 30, 2027, at 8:00 PM, Dragon Arc Events Management proudly presents a truly unique musical milestone: Jay Durias Reimagined: A Musical Tribute by South Border set to take the stage at the prestigious Newport Performing Arts Theater. More than a concert, the event celebrates the music and creative vision of Jay Durias, the singer-songwriter, composer, and musical arranger whose artistry has been instrumental in defining […]...
